identity: ONE original squat mechanical artillery walker, the Redline Crucible Crawler veteran, facing screen right in slightly elevated three-quarter view. Keep the brass and dark iron riveted body, the rounded furnace belly with a glowing orange grille, the compact turret carrying ONE long straight cannon with glowing orange slots along the barrel and a ringed muzzle pointing to screen right, the TWO small lidded glowing crucible pots at the rear of the turret, and EXACTLY FOUR jointed armoured piston legs with three-pronged feet. No crew and no extra legs. Preserve the four legs, the one cannon, the two pots and the squat proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the whole cannon including the muzzle, the pots and all four feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, muzzle flash, smoke, fire, sparks, shells in flight, motion trails, particles or extra legs; the orange slots, grille and pots keep only their steady glow. The machine moves only at its joints and turret pivot; the cannon stays rigid and straight.

idle_h3_v1.action: A rumbling mechanical idle that loops. The body rises and settles on its piston legs, the turret pans a little and the cannon elevates a few degrees then lowers, the crucible lids lift slightly and settle, then everything returns smoothly to the original level stance. All four feet stay planted. No walking and no firing. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place on four legs through two complete cycles with heavy mechanical steps. Diagonal pairs of piston legs alternate lifting, swinging forward and planting their three-pronged feet while the others bear the weight. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel with the cannon held level. Exactly four legs at all times. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE cannon ram toward screen right. The walker settles back onto its rear legs and draws the turret back, then the rear legs push and the body lunges low and forward so the cannon muzzle jabs out to full reach at screen right, the front legs absorb the contact and the body rises back into the original stance. One ram only; nothing is fired.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Fire ONE shot toward screen right. The legs brace wide and the cannon elevates, then the barrel slams back in recoil and the whole walker rocks back on its rear legs with the crucible lids jumping, holds a moment, then the barrel returns, the cannon lowers and the walker settles level into the original stance. One shot only; no flash, smoke, fire or shell is shown.
